title: Bile Sample Collection for the analysis of extracellular RNA
protocol: Collect bile from drainage bags of patients with an indwelling biliary tube into a sterile collection bottle.
Centrifuge the collected bile for 10 minutes at 3000g at 4°C to remove cellular sediment and debris.
Aliquot the centrifuged bile into 1 ml portions in microcentrifuge tubes.
Store the aliquoted bile samples at -20°C.
